skill.summary: Amazon supplier sourcing and development agent. Find manufacturers on Alibaba/1688, evaluate supplier quality, generate RFQ inquiry templates, negotiate MOQ...

latestVersion.changelog:
Amazon supplier sourcing agent initial release.

- Find and evaluate manufacturers on Alibaba/1688 for Amazon FBA products.
- Generate professional RFQ templates and supplier evaluation scorecards.
- Scripts for MOQ and price negotiation plus quality control checklists.
- Includes must-ask supplier questions, red flag checklist, and sourcing timeline commands.
- Tool covers workflow from first supplier search to order quality control.
